entities.summary: Daiki Kameda  is a Japanese former professional boxer who competed from 2006 to 2015. He is a two-weight world champion, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) flyweight title from 2010 to 2011, and the International Boxing Federation (IBF) super-flyweight title from 2013 to 2014. His brothers, Kōki and Tomoki, are also professional boxers.
